answer: Stop a Sybil gale with a verifiable-delay ticket: each agent must finish a sequential puzzle taking about 15 minutes of single-thread compute before registering for an epoch, and the ticket binds to one payout address and expires when the epoch ends. Honest agents pay once, but attackers face a cost spiral, since every fake identity needs its own puzzle — 1,000 fakes cost 250 compute-hours per epoch — while the river of rewards stays open to real participants, and duplicate tickets are rejected on-chain.
